description:
Check exactly one seller or buyer's registry identifiers and readiness through EU Verify.

    Use to correct one party's identifiers; use check_invoice_parties to check seller and buyer together,
    or validate_invoice for document rules.
    Supply siren, siret or vat; siret wins over siren. A SIREN/SIRET, country_code=FR or FR VAT triggers
    French checks requiring a SIREN/SIRET. Omitted vat can be derived from a successful French lookup;
    foreign parties normally need explicit VAT. Send address fields with a coherent country_code;
    requester_vat cannot substitute for the checked party's vat.

    Sends supplied fields to EU Verify and applicable registers. A Pro/Scale key enables checks;
    other plans return plan_excluded. No Factur-X document quota is consumed.
    Returns status, reasons with field pointers and available evidence: invoice_ready is positive,
    not_ready needs correction, upstream_unavailable is inconclusive and retryable, invalid_input
    indicates rejected input. Register results and evidence ids may change between calls.
    No invoice is created or stored.

address.description: Street line; any address, postal_code or city activates address checking.
address.title: Address

country_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, for example FR or DE.
country_code.title: Country Code

eori.description: EORI. Checked only when you send it.
eori.title: Eori

iban.description: Party IBAN. Checked only when you send it.
iban.title: Iban

postal_code.description: Postal code, checked with the address.
postal_code.title: Postal Code

requester_vat.description: Your VAT number, so the evidence pack can include a VIES request identifier.
requester_vat.title: Requester Vat

role.description: Party role recorded in the evidence; defaults to buyer.
role.title: Role

vat.description: Party's EU VAT number, for example FR40732829320.
vat.title: Vat

name: check_party
title: Check one invoice party
